summary: mount_facts sources can be files or the aliases all, static and dynamic (mtab, /proc/mounts, fstab, etc.), with the first definition winning. timeout limits time per mount and should be set via module_defaults during fact gathering.
questions: Which files does mount_facts read by default?
How do I prevent fact gathering from hanging on a stale NFS mount?
Why are mounts listed twice when I add mount as a source?

answer_card.title: mount_facts sources and timeout
answer_card.answer_md:
- `sources`: `all` (default) = `dynamic` (`/etc/mtab`, `/proc/mounts`, `/etc/mnttab`, mount binary) + `static` (`/etc/fstab`, `/etc/vfstab`, AIX `/etc/filesystems`). First definition per mount point wins. Adding both `/proc/mounts` and `mount` duplicates work.
- `timeout`: seconds per mount (null = forever). When used in fact gathering, set via `module_defaults` to avoid hangs.
